Page 1:
Gotta keep trying new things, you know? Like putting on chest waders and letting people shit down the front of them, see how it feels as they fill up.

Transcription:
Shitter: That's it, catch it!
Chloe: Eugh, your shit stinks!
Shitter: Duh, it's shit.

Page 2:
Well, she wasn't just gonna stand there and take it. Once it was near overflowing, Chloe pulled her shirt up and dug her hands into the muck so she could have a bit of a play with it. Probably if she wasn't standing at the edge of a mudpit she'd have a better chance of taking tiny steps. A situation that raises lots of questions...

If a rabbit shits in pants that are extremely full of shit, does it make a sound?
If the rabbit falls forwards, will it all splurt out the top of the waders and cover her up?
Does it feel good to squidge the contents of the pants over her crotch?

Transcription:
Chloe: The waders are so heavy I can't take a step, but it's a nice sunny day to get messy~

Page 3:
So then Chloe kneeled in the mud and smeared poop all over herself, for purposes of pleasure.
